data.one_liner: A Flutter widget that calculates the size of its child at runtime.
data.what_it_does: MeasuredSize wraps a child widget and provides an onChange callback that triggers whenever the child's size changes. It ensures the callback is only executed when the size actually changes and ignores zero sizes.
use_when: You need to dynamically adjust layout based on the rendered size of a child widget.
You want to react to runtime size changes of specific widgets.
avoid_when: You can accomplish the same layout using standard constraints like LayoutBuilder.
You do not need to read the size of the child programmatically.
strengths: Prevents duplicate size change notifications by filtering out identical sizes and Size.zero.
weaknesses: Limited documentation and features beyond basic size observation.
Older package version with no recent updates.
